    COALESCE((sum_y - ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF((n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x), 0)) * sum_x) / n, NULL) AS COL_ALIAS
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT t2.district_id) AS "COUNT( DISTINCT t2.district_id )",
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(t2.a10) AS sum_x,
        SUM(t2.a12) AS sum_y,
        SUM(t2.a10 * t2.a10) AS sum_xx,
        SUM(t2.a10 * t2.a12) AS sum_xy
    FROM client AS t1
    INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id
    WHERE t1.gender = 'F' 
      AND t2.a11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
) AS regression_data
